title: Intel SPTSBP2CLCKS 100G BASE CWDM4 1271-1331nm Single-Mode Duplex LC 2KM SFP Module

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel SPTSBP2CLCKS 100GBASE CWDM4 Optical Transceiver Module delivers exceptional 100Gbps performance for modern data centers, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise backbone networks. Built with Intel’s advanced optical design, this QSFP28 transceiver offers stable, energy-efficient, and long-reach fiber connectivity up to 2KM over SMF.


With CWDM wavelengths ranging from 1271nm to 1331nm, it ensures low-loss transmission and high compatibility with leading network switches and routers that support 100G QSFP28 optics. The Duplex LC interface makes it easy to deploy in high-density environments, providing superior bandwidth and reliability.


Ideal for cloud service providers, ISP backbone upgrades, and enterprise core switching, the Intel SPTSBP2CLCKS module is one of the most dependable mid-range 100G optical solutions available in the market.


Key Features


  • Model: SPTSBP2CLCKS 
  • Brand: Intel
  • Data Rate: 100 Gbps
  • Wavelength: 1271nm to 1331nm
  • Connector Type: LC Duplex
  • Fiber Type: Single-Mode Fiber (SMF)
  • Transmission Distance: Up to 2 km
  • Compatibility: Cisco switches and routers supporting QSFP+
  • Compliant with IEEE 802.3ba 40GBASE-LR4 standard
